title: kissed and citrusy ukrainian ricotta casserole
description: a twist on traditional ukrainian dishes, this citrusy and crisp casserole is a delightful meal prep option made with low-fat ricotta and nimono-simmered components.
instructions: preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit.
in a large mixing bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, unsalted butter, lemon juice, granulated sugar, nimono-simmered carrots and onions, dried thyme, and salt; mix well to combine.
in a separate bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour and beaten eggs.
add the flour mixture to the ricotta mixture and stir until just combined.
transfer the mixture to a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
sprinkle the shredded cheddar cheese evenly over the top.
cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown and the casserole is set.
allow the casserole to cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
serve warm, garnished with additional lemon wedges and chopped fresh herbs if desired.
